entries.array: Create an integer array named energie with five slots.
entries.values: Set energie to the required values: 40, 10, 80, 30 and 60.

entries.array: Create a string array named module with five slots.
entries.values: Assign CPU, RAM, GPU, SSD and NETWORK to the five slots.
entries.remove_gpu: Remove the defective GPU entry from the array.
entries.length: Read the length of the module array.

entries.loop: Use a loop to count only the occupied module entries.
entries.scan: After the code is accepted, pull the scanner lever.

entries.array: Create the package array with the five package weights.
entries.loop: Pass every package to the storage scanner exactly once.

entries.compare: Compare the displayed neighboring pair and decide whether to swap it.

entries.code: Fill in the missing comparison condition and save the code to the sort chip.
entries.machine: Insert the programmed sort chip into the Bubble Sort machine.

entries.arrays: Create the three arrays described by the archive and enter their data.

entries.create: Create a grid with three rows and four columns.
entries.fill: Fill the marked coordinates with their values.
entries.read: Read the requested cell from the grid.

entries.search: Search the grid with nested loops and collect each battery you find.

entries.sort: Check the array sorting in the central computer.
entries.count: Count the occupied entries in modules.
